title: Planning Your Finances Around Upcoming Bank Holidays
description: Indian banks, including SBI and HDFC, observe specific holidays mandated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and state governments. For the week of June 14 to .

faq.q: How do I find out about specific bank holidays in my state?
faq.a: You can check the official Reserve Bank of India (RBI) website under their holiday calendar section, or visit your specific bank's website, which usually lists state-wise holidays.

faq.q: Can I still use ATMs during a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, ATMs are generally operational 24x7, even on bank holidays, allowing you to withdraw cash, check balances, and perform other basic transactions.

faq.q: Are online fund transfers like NEFT and IMPS affected by bank holidays?
faq.a: No, NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) has been available 24x7 since December 2019, and IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) is also available 24x7, 365 days a year.

faq.q: What if I need to deposit a cheque on a bank holiday?
faq.a: You can use the cheque drop-box facility at your bank. However, the cheque will only be processed and cleared on the next working day after the holiday.

faq.q: Do all banks observe the same holidays?
faq.a: No, while national holidays are uniform, many bank holidays are state-specific, based on local festivals or events. It's important to check the calendar for your particular region.

faq.q: Will my credit card or debit card transactions work on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, credit and debit card transactions, both online and at point-of-sale terminals, will function normally as they are processed electronically.

faq.q: What about loan applications or disbursements during a bank holiday?
faq.a: Any loan-related activity requiring a physical branch visit, document submission, or manual processing will be delayed until the next working day.
